<b>Kiliks</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are small bony bugs favouring dark tunnels, capable of expanding their spiked carapace to defend themselves from predators.<ref>Kilik [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Small bony bug that favours dark tunnels. Can expand its spiked carapace to ward against attacking predators."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Kiliks crawl back and forth on ceilings and floors. When approached, they extend their spikes for around 2 seconds before retracting them, with a short cooldown before they can do so again. Kiliks can often be found in narrow tunnels where their spikes completely block passage. While their spikes are extended, they cannot be damaged by the [[Needle]] or the following tools:
* [[Straight Pin]]
* [[Threefold Pin]]
* [[Curveclaw]] / [[Curvesickle]]
* [[Conchcutter]]
* [[Silkshot]] ([[Forge Daughter]] & [[Twelfth Architect]])
* [[Delver's Drill]]
* [[Rosary Cannon]] (Rosaries pass through Kiliks)

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-Threading|Black-threaded]] Kiliks have their health quadrupled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]].

== [[Needolin]] Dialogue ==
{{SS Needolin|columns=2|
*Rumbling, crackling...
*Shells are strong...
*Scratching, seeking...
*Warm and dark...
*Digging, hiding...
*Claws are sharp...
}}

== Location ==

Kiliks can be found primarily in [[the Marrow]], but they also appear in the [[Memorium]] and in the [[Chapel of the Beast]] within [[Hunter's March]], where they can also be summoned by a [[Savage Beastfly]].
